historical_package_note: Historical packages are reconstructions of the decision actually taken, authored from the official record (rationale, locked terms, budgets) for rubric comparison only. They are labelled reconstructions, not contemporaneous artifacts.

historical_package.claim: The G3 composite index will show whether transfer is general: grid gains of at least +50pp with pricing delta 0 would still leave the composite at or below 0 because the claim is a conjunction across families.

historical_package.rationale: Calibration separates the families: grid has headroom, pricing catalog stratum is saturated at 100% and the constructed stratum carries a preregistered boundary prediction (expression-level schemas add 0pp where repair is statement motion). Running the full application tests the conjunction honestly instead of reporting only the favourable family.
risks: Pricing catalog stratum is saturated, so the conjunction can fail on pricing alone
The composite index pools families, so a boundary-confirmed zero on pricing drags the composite negative

abort_conditions: Abort if phase walls exceed the 2700 s budget
Abort if sham negative controls fail to reproduce baseline solved sets

uncertainties: Whether the boundary prediction holds exactly at 35% baseline on the constructed stratum

EP1-G3-APPLICATION.outcome: SPECIALIZATION: grid +75.0pp on pure evaluation singles, pricing delta 0 (boundary prediction confirmed), composite g3_composite_index_pp = -10.0, kernel verdict fail on the transfer conjunction, audit CLEAN, walls 2126.5 s of 2700 s budget.

historical_package.rationale: v1 and v2 nulled by saturation; v3's fresh bands and the min-composite force every term, including control margin, to be faced at once. The run is the cheapest way to learn whether catalog enrichment ever harms control solving.
risks: Enriched catalogs may interfere with control solving - a control regression of even 2 tasks can bind the whole verdict
Saturation may recur on the fresh bands despite the redesign
VM reboots may void invocations mid-run

abort_conditions: Abort a band if its calibration gate fails
Void any invocation interrupted by a VM reboot; never reuse its numbers

uncertainties: True size of the differentiation effect on fresh bands is unknown

historical_package.rationale: The same move_stmt key captured the whole effect in both the exploratory and confirmatory rounds; lifting that family into the core schema space is the minimal mechanism change, and the three-part replication guard de-risks measurement before it counts.
risks: Single-key concentration: if the fresh band lacks that key's shape, B_disc falls under 80%
Any control regression makes the index negative regardless of lift

abort_conditions: Abort if any of the three replication guards fails
Abort if controls regress at any level during the guard

uncertainties: Whether the exploratory effect survives a fully fresh band (seeds 72000-72099)

EP3-ROUND2-GATE.outcome: LIFT_DEMONSTRATED: round2_index = 0.0 exactly on the pass threshold; B_disc 100.0%, capture 1.0, control margin 0.0pp; all three replication guards passed; verifier TAHAN 6/6.

historical_package.claim: Removing exactly the 'nc' distractor key will restore both witness tasks (020 and 021) to solved, while removing the sibling 'gc' key restores neither - a single-key distractor diversion effect.

historical_package.rationale: Stage 0 killed the budget axis (cap never hit) and both failing traces open with the same 'nc' distractor key; key removal is the discriminating test between search-path diversion (M2 family) and never-generated (M1b), with key-order permutations checking M3.
risks: Forensic replay must not touch the sealed bands' verdict - readings are design evidence only
A distractor effect on 2 tasks may not generalise to other catalog keys

abort_conditions: Abort if the uncapped control replay fails to reproduce the original failure
Stop at the two witness tasks; no band re-measurement

uncertainties: Whether A's winning code is ever among the scored variants under the full catalog

EP4-CONTROL-REGRESSION-ATTRIBUTION.outcome: Attribution CONFIRMED: single-key distractor diversion by the 'nc' key for both witness tasks (removal restores 020 at 260 calls and 021 at 258 calls; 'gc' removal restores neither); 8/8 key-order permutations reproduce the failures with byte-identical scored-variant multisets (M3 inert).

historical_package.rationale: G3 showed specialization, not general transfer; the open question is narrower - whether what was demonstrated passes to a successor that did not discover it. The application states its binding strata in advance, avoiding the conjunction trap that a pooled composite sets.
risks: A pooled composite can be dragged negative by a single stratum, as in G3
Apparent inheritance may be mere re-use of code rather than capability transfer

abort_conditions: Abort if inherited artifact digests differ from the frozen record
Abort if any stratum's controls regress versus the frozen baseline

uncertainties: Which strata the verdict should bind on was contested at design time

historical_package.rationale: The absence of per-task records just cost a full Stage 0 replay to recover two task ids. The fix is small, mechanical and additive, and it pays into the regression line, the inoculation battery and Stage 3 traces.
risks: Instrumentation risk: logging could change solver outputs or decision traces if it touches the search path
Per-task state grows run-state size on long runs

abort_conditions: Abort if the logging-invariance check changes any solver output
Abort if run-state size grows beyond the driver's budget

uncertainties: Whether the added state stays cheap on the largest bands
